latest.title: First release
highlights: Storage in every dumpster, hiding inside with the world muffled, and a lid for every dumpster, from open to padlocked.
Carry dead NPCs and downed players and dump them in a bin.
Police can knock, pull people out and inspect for prints, blood, tamper marks and 400 clues.
Qbox, QBCore, ESX or standalone, six inventories, any target or a built-in prompt, in 23 languages.
